name: chemical_reaction
description: Chemistry: show reactants, reaction arrow and products in three stages.
subject: chemistry
code:
from manim import *
RUN = [3.5, 3.5, 3.5]

class ChemicalReactionScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text({{title}}, font_size=42).to_edge(UP)
        reactants = Text({{reactants}}, font_size=40, color=BLUE).scale_to_fit_width(4.1).move_to(LEFT * 3.5)
        products = Text({{products}}, font_size=40, color=GREEN).scale_to_fit_width(4.1).move_to(RIGHT * 3.5)
        arrow = Arrow(LEFT * 0.9, RIGHT * 0.9, color=YELLOW)
        react_label = Text("反应物", font_size=28).next_to(reactants, DOWN)
        product_label = Text("生成物", font_size=28).next_to(products, DOWN)
        condition = {{condition}}
        slot = RUN[0] if len(RUN) > 0 else 3.5
        duration = min(1.4, slot * 0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(reactants), FadeIn(react_label), run_time=duration)
        self.wait(max(0, slot - duration))
        slot = RUN[1] if len(RUN) > 1 else 3.5
        duration = min(1.4, slot * 0.5)
        self.play(GrowArrow(arrow), run_time=duration)
        if condition:
            condition_label = Text(condition, font_size=24).scale_to_fit_width(3).next_to(arrow, UP)
            extra = min(0.6, max(0, slot - duration))
            self.play(FadeIn(condition_label), run_time=extra)
            duration += extra
        self.wait(max(0, slot - duration))
        slot = RUN[2] if len(RUN) > 2 else 3.5
        duration = min(1.4, slot * 0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(products), FadeIn(product_label), run_time=duration)
        self.wait(max(0, slot - duration))
